title: Elemental and morphological diversity of individual magnetic particles from urban surfaces: implications for adverse health outcomes
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00544B, Paper
Xiangxing Long, Jonas Wielinski, Zhe Zhao, Pierre Herckes, Manuel A. Roldan, Gregory V. Lowry, Paul Westerhoff
Integrating spICP-TOFMS and STEM-EDX enables comprehensive single-particle analysis of urban magnetic dust particles, revealing their heterogeneous composition, trace metal co-occurrence, and potential health implications.
